info.title: Costs Service
info.description: Cost tracking and budget management service

RunId.description: Run UUID from runs-service identifying the current execution

BrandId.description: Brand identifier(s) injected by workflow-service (optional). Supports comma-separated UUIDs for multi-brand campaigns, e.g. 'uuid1,uuid2,uuid3'.

FeatureSlug.description: Feature slug for tracking which feature triggered the request (optional)

AudienceId.description: Priority audience identifier chosen by campaign-service for cost attribution, injected by workflow-service (optional)

costPerUnitInUsdCents.description: The price we charge per unit, or null when this line carries NO billable price any more (a cost we still incur but stopped rebilling — the cold-email infrastructure lines). Null is not zero: zero would assert the line is free, which is false. A null-priced newest version delists the name from the current catalog listing while every by-name read keeps resolving it, so spend already declared against the name stays readable.

pricingBasis.description: Whether this line carries a markup. 'pass-through' means the price IS the vendor's — money we merely route (advertising-platform spend, payment-processing fees) reaches the customer at cost, with no markup. 'marked-up' means work we perform (LLM tokens, embeddings, enrichment, search, creative generation), priced at the vendor rate times the store multiplier. Always present: a line's class is never inferred by the caller.

pricingRegime.description: Time-of-day pricing regime this price belongs to ('peak' or 'off-peak'), or null when the provider charges one rate at every hour. The cost name carries the same segment.

regimeHoursUtc.description: UTC windows during which this regime is in force, as comma-separated half-open HH:MM-HH:MM ranges. Null when pricingRegime is null. A provider's regimes partition the day, so exactly one cost name matches any instant.

pricingBasis.description: Required. 'pass-through' for money we route at the vendor price (ad-platform spend, payment fees), 'marked-up' for work we perform. No default — a price point whose class is unstated is rejected.

pricePerUnitInUsdCents.description: Current price per unit, or null when the line has no billable price any more. Never zero for a delisted line: absence of a price is the honest representation of 'we still pay for this, we just stopped charging for it'.

billable.description: Whether this line is something we currently charge for. False only on a delisted line, which is served by name for historical reads but never appears in GET /v1/platform-prices.

pricingBasis.description: Whether this line carries a markup. 'pass-through' means the price IS the vendor's — money we merely route (advertising-platform spend, payment-processing fees) reaches the customer at cost, with no markup. 'marked-up' means work we perform (LLM tokens, embeddings, enrichment, search, creative generation), priced at the vendor rate times the store multiplier. Always present: a line's class is never inferred by the caller.

pricingRegime.description: Time-of-day pricing regime this price belongs to ('peak' or 'off-peak'), or null when the provider charges one rate at every hour. The cost name carries the same segment, so a consumer picks the name for a moment rather than computing a rate.

regimeHoursUtc.description: UTC windows during which this regime is in force, as comma-separated half-open HH:MM-HH:MM ranges (a window may wrap past 24:00 only as the literal end 24:00). Null when pricingRegime is null. A provider's regimes partition the day, so for a given model and token class exactly one cost name matches any instant.

id.description: The providers_costs row (price version) id — a uuid, or a synthetic 'reconstructed:<name>:<plan>:<billed>' id on a reconstructed version.

unit.description: Null only on a reconstructed version.

billedPricePerUnitInUsdCents.description: The price this version charged per unit — byte-equal to what /v1/platform-prices/{name} served while it was in force. Null on a delisted version.

vendorCostPerUnitInUsdCents.description: What one unit REALLY cost us from the vendor at this version, before our markup, non-recoverable VAT included (DeepSeek: list price x 1.06). Stated only when a vendor rate on record reproduces the billed price exactly under the markup in force when the version was written. Null = unknown (see vendorCostUnknownReason); never the billed price, never billed / today's multiplier.

markupMultiplier.description: billed / vendor for this version (4 decimals), e.g. '6.0000' in the 6x era, '1.0000' for pass-through. Null when unknown, or when the vendor cost is 0.

vendorCostDerivation.description: How the vendor cost was stated. 'seed-vendor-rate' / '-pre-vat': a vendor rate the seed carried (today or in its history) reproduces the billed price under the markup in force when the version was written. 'pass-through': billed = vendor.

vendorCostNote.description: Why a reconstructed version exists, in words. Null on a catalogue version.

reconstructed.description: True for a price version overwritten in place before v0.25.0 (2026-06-07) and therefore absent from the catalogue: listed so a cost row that froze its price can still be priced. Its id is synthetic, effectiveFrom = createdAt = the first day it was billed, and markupMultiplier is null (it prices old cost rows; it is not a markup in force).

createdAt.description: When this version was written. It was served from max(effectiveFrom, createdAt).

ledgerGeneratedAt.description: When the bank ledger produced the answer (read live, never cached).

match.description: 'unmatched' = no vendor in the bank ledger could be tied to this provider (we cannot say who pays it), distinct from a matched provider.

ledgerVendors.description: The ledger vendors joined to this provider (a vendor key starting with the provider's name or domain, longest name wins).

lastPaidOn.description: Latest payment across every account (YYYY-MM-DD). Null when unmatched.

paidFrom.description: Accounts that paid this provider, most recent first. Empty when unmatched.

institutionDomain.description: Bank domain for a logo (logo.dev). Null when the ledger does not know the bank.

lastPaidOn.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) this account last paid this provider.

asOf.description: Day of the latest point = the day `currentPriceUsdCents` is for

refreshedAt.description: When the served series was computed

stale.description: True when the served series was not computed today (UTC): the last refresh failed or has not run yet

currentPriceUsdCents.description: US cents per email sent to a lead, since inception, on NET spend (paid minus refunded)

currentGrossPriceUsdCents.description: Same on GROSS paid (refunds ignored), shown beside

spendUsd.description: Net consumed since inception = paidUsd - refundedUsd: the numerator of the price

refundedUsd.description: Money the vendors gave back since inception

vendors.description: The vendors counted as email infrastructure, declared in costs-service

spendByVendorUsd.description: Net per vendor key that month

cumulativeSpendUsd.description: At the month's last point (month end, or today)

asOf.description: UTC day the attempt computed for, YYYY-MM-DD

error.description: Why the attempt failed (upstream named), null otherwise

EmailSendPriceRefreshAttempt.description: The most recent attempt, failed ones included

day.description: YYYY-MM-DD; dense, one point per calendar day from the first payment or send

spendUsd.description: Net email-infrastructure spend booked that day (paid minus refunded), USD; negative on a refund-only day

emailsToLeads.description: Emails sent to leads that UTC day

priceUsdCents.description: cumulativeSpendUsd*100 / cumulativeEmailsToLeads (net); null before the first send

cumulativePaidUsd.description: Gross: every payment since inception, refunds ignored

monthPriceUsdCents.description: This calendar month alone (net), through this day; null when the month sent nothing yet or its net spend is negative

stale.description: True when the served series was not computed today (UTC)

ledgerMatched.description: False = no bank-ledger line declared: money fields are null (unknown), never 0

orgKeyUnitsCounted.description: Whether units runs-service tags 'org' (customer key) are counted as our credits

credits.description: Credits consumed through our account since 2026-01-01: the denominator

costPerCreditUsdCents.description: Real cost of one credit, US cents, on NET paid

quantityPlatformKey.description: Units since 2026-01-01 through our platform key

quantityOrgKey.description: Units since 2026-01-01 runs-service tags as a customer's own key

vendorCostPerUnitInUsdCents.description: Catalogue vendor cost of that version

catalogueNote.description: Why the catalogue fields are null

costPerCreditUsdCents.description: Running since 2026-01-01 at the month's last point

day.description: YYYY-MM-DD; dense, one point per calendar day from 2026-01-01

paidUsd.description: Paid to the ledger vendor(s) that day, USD; null when the subscription has no ledger line

credits.description: Credits consumed through our account that UTC day

costPerCreditUsdCents.description: cumulativeNetUsd*100 / cumulativeCredits; null over zero credits, a negative net, or no ledger line

flag.description: Why the item fell back to its catalogue vendor cost (or kept its price); null = its specific real cost applies

ratio.description: Pay-as-you-go: net paid / vendor cost recorded, through the day

multiplier.description: 2 for production tools, 1 for pass-through (Stripe, media)
